public_state_prerequisites: bid winner; declaration; own hand; legal opening leads; bid margin; public score mode
book_concept: Bidder owns first lead and must choose whether to pull trump, lead a planned off, cash count, or preserve reentry
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers declaration, hand trump/called/count fractions, lead position, legal trump/count fractions; v1 map names pull_trump_vs_early_off_window, candidate_bid_loss_budget, side_specific_off_risk
missing_detector: bidder_first_lead_plan: classifies trump-pull, planned-off, count-cash, reentry-save, and low-trump-first exception under current bid margin
suggested_metric: paired E[Q] delta and make/set threshold mass for first-lead class versus best legal action
leakage_risk: Online detector must not use true opponent holdings; hidden owner explanation is eval-only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs per-action PDF quantiles, make-threshold mass, bid-margin labels, off-risk labels, and hidden-threat attribution for reports

public_state_prerequisites: bidder leads; P1 relation is left opponent; legal mask; current trick led suit; candidate beats/loses; current trick count; public void evidence
book_concept: First setter can pounce immediately when bidder exposes an off or count window, but should obey follow-suit and avoid low count-caller traps
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers trick_position_fraction, follows_led, beats_current, opponent_currently_winning, current_trick_count_point_frac, count_donation_to_opponent; v1 map names setter_pounce_window and count_before_certainty
missing_detector: first_setter_pounce_window: public approximation of bidder-off exposure plus count-to-set pressure for P1 before partner acts
suggested_metric: missed-pounce regret, set conversion, and held-count-never-used rate split by forced-follow versus free-discard
leakage_risk: Actual bidder off inventory and partner winner ownership are hidden-truth labels; use only public bidder lead shape online
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs p_set threshold mass, disaster-tail CVaR, count-needed-to-set, and public/offline split for partner-winner outcomes

public_state_prerequisites: bidder is partner; P0/P1 plays visible; current winner; legal mask; candidate count value; overtrump risk
book_concept: Partner support waits for safe count donation when partner is winning or likely protected; unsafe count dumps can feed setters
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers partner_currently_winning, point_dump, count_donation_to_partner, current_trick_has_trump, is_last_to_play false; v1 map names safe_partner_count_donation
missing_detector: partner_third_seat_safe_donation: distinguishes guaranteed partner win, likely partner win, and speculative donation after setter action
suggested_metric: donation precision, missed safe-donation rate, and lower-tail regret for donated count
leakage_risk: Online likely-win must be public-state or belief-derived; true hidden overtrump availability is eval-only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs distribution tail labels for unsafe donation, partner-currently-winning certainty, overtrump probability, and belief calibration

public_state_prerequisites: first three plays visible; legal mask; current winner; team relation; count on trick; bid/set margin
book_concept: Last-to-act can cash, save, overtrump, or discard with maximum public information; book advice is strongly position-sensitive here
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers is_last_to_play, beats_current, partner/opponent_currently_winning, trump_in, point_dump; v1 map names count_before_certainty and count_protection_throwaway
missing_detector: last_to_act_closure_policy: labels save/beat/dump/duck choices by team winner, count value, and bid/set margin
suggested_metric: regret by closure class, count captured/saved, and tail loss when declining to beat current winner
leakage_risk: Low leakage for public closure facts; future-result labels are eval-only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs per-action E[Q] PDF, count swing, make/set threshold mass, and action-class bucket movement

public_state_prerequisites: bidder retained lead; trump declaration; outstanding public trump; played suit counts; own remaining trumps; bid margin
book_concept: Pull trump by default but preserve reentry or switch when dangerous outstanding trump and count needs make the original script unsafe
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers hand_trump_frac, unseen_called_frac, current_trick_trump_frac, is_lead_position; v1 map names pull_trump_vs_early_off_window and dangerous outstanding trump crisis in chapter map only indirectly
missing_detector: outstanding_trump_crisis: public/belief label for when remaining trump risk plus count need favors crisis count forcing over another trump lead
suggested_metric: paired E[Q] regret for trump-pull versus count-forcing or off-plan alternatives; p_make cliff movement
leakage_risk: True owner of dangerous trump is eval-only; online version must use public depletion plus belief
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs outstanding-trump distribution, owner-impact magnitude, p_make quantiles, and branch labels

public_state_prerequisites: current trick led by another seat; legal follow/slough; bidder team score; count remaining; own trump scarcity
book_concept: Emergency trump-in can be correct even when it spends scarce control if the current trick threatens immediate set
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers must_follow_or_restricted, beats_current, trump_in, current_trick_count_point_frac; v1 map names count_protection_throwaway but not emergency bidder trump-in directly
missing_detector: emergency_trump_in_to_prevent_set: bidder follower state where current count loss crosses bid failure threshold
suggested_metric: catastrophic-set avoidance rate and regret of trumping now versus saving trump
leakage_risk: Low for public trick/count facts; future line attribution is eval-only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs bid-margin state, lower-tail/CVaR, make-threshold mass, and count-threat labels

public_state_prerequisites: defender won prior trick; defender has lead; bid amount; points needed to set; legal lead classes; public voids
book_concept: Setter lead should maximize damage: call count, force bidder trump, or sneak count depending on bid margin and position
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers is_lead_position, legal_count_point_frac, legal_double_frac, visible pip coverage; v1 map names setter_pounce_window and count_before_certainty but not lead-class damage directly
missing_detector: defender_damage_lead_class: count-calling lead, force-trump lead, safe low lead, or one-point-to-set exception
suggested_metric: set conversion and E[Q] delta by lead class; false-positive low count-caller tail regret
leakage_risk: Hidden bidder hand/off identity is report-only; online uses public bid/play inference
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs p_set threshold mass, count-needed-to-set, public void labels, and hidden off attribution for diagnostics

public_state_prerequisites: bidder off or apparent off led; P1/P3 before partner; legal mask; count in own hand; partner-currently-winning unknown/false
book_concept: Setting often allows count before certainty, unlike partner support, especially against 35/36 bids
current_detector_coverage: v0 has count_donation_to_opponent and partner/opponent-currently-winning tags but no set-margin role gate; v1 map names count_before_certainty
missing_detector: setter_count_before_certainty: count play by defender before partner has proved winner, gated by set pressure
suggested_metric: E[Q] delta for count versus non-count, set conversion, held-count-never-used rate in high-bid buckets
leakage_risk: True partner winner ownership and hidden bidder off are eval-only; public detector must mark uncertainty
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs high-bid bucket, set-margin, outcome PDF split by partner winner, and tail-risk labels

public_state_prerequisites: partner bidder not currently winning; legal mask; current trick count; bidder likely control; own count/protectors
book_concept: Partner should avoid feeding count unless the bidder's trick is secure or the donation is forced by follow/void constraints
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers count_donation_to_partner, partner_currently_winning, follows_led, point_dump; v1 map names safe_partner_count_donation
missing_detector: partner_forcedness_and_safety: separates forced count, safe count, speculative count, and destructive non-donation
suggested_metric: unsafe donation tail regret, missed donation when partner certainly wins, and forcedness precision
leakage_risk: Online safety cannot inspect hidden overtrump owners; use public current-winner and legal mask only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs forcedness label, overtrump probability, p_make threshold mass, and belief-quality metrics

public_state_prerequisites: trick index high; three plays visible; live count remaining; legal mask; current score against bid; remaining trick count
book_concept: Late trick decisions are threshold decisions: one point, one count tile, or one saved winner can flip make/set
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers trick_index_fraction, is_last_to_play, current_trick pressure, played/unseen count fractions; v1 map has scoring and pounce buckets but no generic late-threshold detector
missing_detector: late_trick_threshold_closure: labels decisions where action changes make/set threshold mass more than mean E[Q] suggests
suggested_metric: bucket-shift in make/set probability, lower-tail risk, and regret for declining/choosing current trick winner
leakage_risk: Low for public state; exact future threshold attribution is eval-only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs p_make/p_set mass, quantiles, remaining-count inventory, and phase-2 threshold-cliff labels

public_state_prerequisites: bid value 84; declaration; own hand; trick index; public trump/suit depletion; legal leads
book_concept: 84 bidder cares about taking every trick, preserving final walkers, proving laydown, and not treating ordinary count as the objective
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers declaration/bid only indirectly through decl tags and phase/action identity; v1 map names 84_contract_regime, laydown_84_proof, protected_one_off_84_shape, final_walker_counter
missing_detector: eighty_four_bidder_asset_plan: tracks laydown proof, protected off, final walker, and abandonment trigger for each lead/follow choice
suggested_metric: trick-loss probability, p_take_all threshold mass, regret by asset-preservation class
leakage_risk: Hidden defender assets are eval-only; online proof can use own hand plus public depletion only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs 84-specific distribution labels, final-weapon survival, p_take_all mass, and branch labels for first lost trick

public_state_prerequisites: bid value 84; defender hand; public played tiles; possible final-off suits; legal discard/follow choices
book_concept: 84 defenders preserve live doubles, same-suit pairs, and protectors; abandon dead assets when public play kills the target
current_detector_coverage: v0 has double/action identity and late phase but no live 84 weapon concept; v1 map names live_final_weapon_tiles, live_same_suit_pair, throwaway_ladder_rank, 84_set_attribution
missing_detector: eighty_four_live_asset_ladder: ranks legal actions by preserving live double, pair, protector, or releasing dead assets
suggested_metric: set conversion, voluntary-break regret, asset survival to trick 7, and tracking-load error rate
leakage_risk: Full bidder final-off structure is hidden; public live-asset detector must enumerate plausible worlds, with true attribution offline
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs live-asset count, forced-vs-voluntary break labels, p_set_84 mass, and asset-lineage attribution

public_state_prerequisites: candidate or actual doubles declaration; own double count/ranks; legal action set; native suit recomputation
book_concept: Doubles as trump removes doubles from native suits and creates planned low-double sacrifices and walker plans
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers decl_7_doubles_trump, hand_double_frac, legal_double_frac, double action identity; v1 map names doubles_native_suit_removal and planned_low_double_sacrifice
missing_detector: doubles_regime_plan: paired declaration/play detector for low-double sacrifice, planned-loss budget, and double-native-suit removal
suggested_metric: declaration E[Q] delta, planned-loss survival, legal/regime correctness, and tail set after first lost double
leakage_risk: Low for rules substrate; hidden response holdings and realized sacrifice success are eval-only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs paired declaration labels, planned-loss budget, first-trick PDF, and suit-top recomputation labels

public_state_prerequisites: candidate or actual no-trump declaration; own doubles/support doubles; public suit tops; legal leads; lead control
book_concept: No-trump replaces trump control with lead-control fragility and support-double preservation ahead of offs
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers decl_9_notrump, double identity, own/visible pip coverage, but no no-trump control concept; v1 map names no_trump_support_double_preservation and dynamic_no_trump_suit_counter
missing_detector: no_trump_lead_control_and_support: marks loss of reentry, support-double preservation, and same-hand no-trump versus doubles-trump comparison
suggested_metric: paired declaration E[Q], lead-loss tail regret, support-double preservation regret
leakage_risk: Hidden suit tops can be report-only; online must use public remaining tiles and own hand
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs no-trump declaration comparison, p_make distribution, lead-control state, and support-double asset labels

public_state_prerequisites: dealer/shuffler/seat order; current high bid; partner/opponent bid status; own hand; candidate bid
book_concept: Last-to-act auction choices should separate minimum winning bid, partner support, and natural bid anomalies such as 32/33 raises
current_detector_coverage: v0 play tags do not cover bidding action directly except declaration and hand shape after the fact; v1 map names unnecessary_bid_margin and natural_bid_bucket_anomaly
missing_detector: auction_position_bid_margin: seat-aware bid/pass/raise detector with minimum-winning and partner-already-bid gates
suggested_metric: overbid tail regret, underbid loss-to-opponent rate, natural-bucket calibration
leakage_risk: Partner hidden hand cannot be live input; partner bid/pass is public signal only
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs auction counterfactuals, score mode, partner-bid signal labels, and bid-ceiling distribution

public_state_prerequisites: complete first trick; trick winner; public plays by seat; declaration; observed follow/void evidence
book_concept: First trick updates role vocabulary: who controls lead, who was void or forced, and where count/trump threats may now sit
current_detector_coverage: v0 covers lead transition ingredients, void summaries, played/visible pip coverage; v1 map names early_trick_belief_discovery
missing_detector: first_trick_public_belief_update: records legal public implications from each seat's play and follow/fail-to-follow pattern
suggested_metric: belief Brier/log-loss shift and downstream regret after first-trick public update
leakage_risk: True hidden owner labels are eval-only; online output is a public-evidence feature or learned belief
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs distribution labels for high-impact hidden tiles, owner-impact magnitude, and belief calibration deltas

public_state_prerequisites: visible prompt state; tool calls; final action; public evidence only; optional oracle labels for eval
book_concept: Role language should stay faithful: bidder/setter/partner/defender, leader/follower/last-to-act, and no illegal table-talk inference
current_detector_coverage: v0/v1 are state tags, not rationale tags; v1 map names trace_public_evidence_faithfulness and legal_inference_boundary
missing_detector: role_language_faithfulness_audit: trace lint for seat/role claims, hidden leakage, count arithmetic, and tool-use grounding
suggested_metric: unsupported hidden-claim rate, count-math error rate, action regret paired with rationale bucket
leakage_risk: Trace audit may read model text; hidden truth only for eval labeling, never as allowed rationale evidence
phase2_stats_distribution_dependencies: Needs Burl trace labels, public-state reconstruction, oracle regret, and leakage taxonomy
